show.description: Tarun, a wealthy heir rebelling against his mother’s arranged marriage plans, hides his identity as a cleaning staff. Sneha, an orphaned bride abandoned at the altar, impulsively proposes marriage to Neel. What begins as a marriage of convenience transforms into a journey of trust, loyalty, and love as they navigate class divides, hidden truths, and personal scars - proving that love can bloom in the most unexpected places. Watch Now!
